name: io.github.buildngrowsv/pennycompute
title: PennyCompute
description: Estimate, submit, inspect and retrieve PennyCompute media jobs.

tools.name: upscale_image
tools.description: Real-ESRGAN x4plus outputs PNG at 4× source width and height. $0.001 per image. Failed jobs are free.

tools.name: remove_background
tools.description: BiRefNet outputs a transparent PNG at source dimensions. $0.0003 per image. Failed jobs are free.

tools.name: generate_speech
tools.description: Kokoro-82M costs $0.000495 per 1,000 characters, prorated per character. Failed jobs are free.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: FLUX.2 klein 4B costs $0.0047 per 1024×1024 image. 1024×1024 PNG only; no other sizes or aspect ratios; no edit endpoint; no LoRA. Failed jobs are free.

tools.name: transcribe_audio
tools.description: Whisper large-v3-turbo costs $0.0001 per audio minute, prorated per second. Failed jobs are free.

tools.name: estimate_job
tools.description: Estimate a public API job without creating it. Real-ESRGAN x4plus outputs PNG at 4× source width and height. $0.001 per image. BiRefNet outputs a transparent PNG at source dimensions. $0.0003 per image. Kokoro-82M costs $0.000495 per 1,000 characters, prorated per character. FLUX.2 klein 4B costs $0.0047 per 1024×1024 image. 1024×1024 PNG only; no other sizes or aspect ratios; no edit endpoint; no LoRA. Whisper large-v3-turbo costs $0.0001 per audio minute, prorated per second. A five-second 480p H3 clip is $0.025; FFmpeg HD output is $0.0075 per minute with a 1-second minimum; Remotion is $0.0037 per render plus $0.0048 per minute through 1080p. Failed jobs are free.

tools.name: submit_remotion_render
tools.description: Submit a Remotion render. The live rate is $0.0037 per render plus $0.0048 per minute through 1080p or $0.017 above 1080p. Failed jobs are free.

tools.name: submit_ffmpeg_job
tools.description: Submit a transcode, stitch, audio mix, caption burn, timeline export, frame grab, or audio job. Video is $0.00375 per SD minute, $0.0075 per HD minute, or $0.015 per 4K minute; audio is $0.0015 per minute, with a 1-second minimum. Use estimate_job for an image. Failed jobs are free.

tools.name: submit_h3_clip
tools.description: Submit one five-second 480p H3 image-to-video clip for $0.025. Failed jobs are free.

tools.name: upload_asset
tools.description: Prepare an input file or Remotion bundle through the public assets API and return its upload and input or serve URLs. Failed jobs are free.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Read a job, including its status and final charge. Failed jobs are free.

tools.name: get_job_result
tools.description: Return the public download URL for a succeeded job. Failed jobs are free.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List jobs newest first, with the public API filters and cursor. Failed jobs are free.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Read the prepaid and outstanding balances in millionths of a US dollar. Failed jobs are free.
